subcommands.description: Azure services and related problem categories
subcommands.name: services

subcommands.description: Lists all the Azure services available for support ticket creation. Always use the service and it's corresponding problem classification(s) obtained programmatically for support ticket creation. This practice ensures that you always have the most recent set of service and problem classification Ids
subcommands.name: list

subcommands.description: Gets a specific Azure service for support ticket creation
subcommands.name: show

subcommands.description: Problem classifications for an Azure service
subcommands.name: problem-classifications

subcommands.description: Lists all the problem classifications (categories) available for an Azure service. Always use the service and it's corresponding problem classification(s) obtained programmatically for support ticket creation. This practice ensures that you always have the most recent set of service and problem classification Ids
subcommands.name: list

subcommands.description: Gets the problem classification details for an Azure service
subcommands.name: show

subcommands.description: Create and manage Azure support ticket
subcommands.name: tickets

subcommands.description: Creates a new support ticket for Quota increase, Technical, Billing, and Subscription Management issues for the specified subscription
subcommands.name: create

options.description: Country of the user. This is the ISO Alpha-3 code
options.name: --contact-country

options.description: Preferred language of support from Azure. Support languages vary based on the severity you choose for your support ticket. This is the standard country-language code
options.name: --contact-language

options.description: Time zone of the user. This is the name of the time zone from Microsoft Time Zone Index Values
options.name: --contact-timezone

options.description: Detailed description of the question or issue
options.name: --description

options.description: Each Azure service has its own set of issue category called problem classification that corresponds to the type of problem you are experiencing. This parameter is the resource id of ProblemClassification resource
options.name: --problem-classification

options.description: A value that indicates the urgency of the case, which in turn determines the response time according to the service level agreement of the technical support plan you have with Azure
options.name: --severity

options.description: Space-separated list of additional email addresses. Additional email addresses will be copied on any correspondence about the support ticket
options.name: --contact-additional-emails

options.description: Phone number. This is required if preferred contact method is phone
options.name: --contact-phone-number

options.description: Partner tenant id for Admin On Behalf of (AOBO) scenario. In addition to logging in to the customer tenant, logging in to the partner tenant (PT) using "az login -t PT --allow-no-subscriptions" is required
options.name: --partner-tenant-id

options.description: Space -separated list of serialized payload of the quota increase request corresponding to regions. Visit https://aka.ms/supportrpquotarequestpayload for details
options.name: --quota-change-payload

options.description: Space-separated list of region for which the quota increase request is being made
options.name: --quota-change-regions

options.description: Required for certain quota types when there is a sub type that you are requesting quota increase for. Example: Batch
options.name: --quota-change-subtype

options.description: Indicates if this requires a 24x7 response from Azure. Default is false
options.name: --require-24-by-7-response

options.description: Time in UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z') when the problem started. Default is today
options.name: --start-time

options.description: This is the resource id of the Azure service resource for which the support ticket is created
options.name: --technical-resource

subcommands.description: Lists all the support tickets for an Azure subscription
subcommands.name: list

options.description: The filter to apply on the operation. We support OData v4.0 semtantics. Filter can be specified on "Status" property using eq operator or on "CreatedDate" using gt/ge. To combine both filters, use the logical and operator. Default is CreatedDate >= one week
options.name: --filters
